items.title: MemoryCD: Benchmarking Long-Context User Memory of LLM Agents for Lifelong Cross-Domain Personalization
items.title_zh: MemoryCD：面向终身跨域个性化的 LLM Agent 长上下文用户记忆基准
items.summary: MemoryCD is described as the first large-scale, user-centric, cross-domain memory benchmark, built from lifelong real-world behaviors in the Amazon Review dataset. It evaluates 14 LLM base models and 6 memory methods on 4 personalization tasks across 12 domains and finds existing memory methods fall short of user satisfaction.

items.title: Robust Reasoning Benchmark
items.title_zh: Robust Reasoning Benchmark：文本扰动下的推理鲁棒性基准
items.summary: The Robust Reasoning Benchmark applies 13 deterministic textual perturbations to AIME 2024 and AIME 2025 and evaluates eight state-of-the-art models. Frontier models are largely resilient except Claude, which often refuses transformed prompts, while open-weight reasoning models show failure modes with up to 54% average accuracy drops and up to 100% on some perturbations.

items.title: When Chain-of-Thought Backfires: Evaluating Prompt Sensitivity in Medical Language Models
items.title_zh: 当思维链适得其反：评估医学语言模型的提示敏感性
items.summary: The authors evaluate MedGemma models on MedMCQA and PubMedQA and find chain-of-thought prompting lowers accuracy by 5.7% versus direct answering, while few-shot examples degrade performance by 11.9%. Shuffling answer options changed predictions 59.1% of the time, and cloze scoring outperformed all prompting strategies.

items.title: Runtime Burden Allocation for Structured LLM Routing in Agentic Expert Systems: A Full-Factorial Cross-Backend Methodology
items.title_zh: 智能体专家系统中结构化 LLM 路由的运行时负担分配：全因子跨后端方法
items.summary: The paper frames structured LLM routing as a systems-level burden-allocation problem and benchmarks 48 deployment configurations and 15,552 requests across OpenAI, Gemini and Llama backends. It finds no universal best routing mode: modes reliable on Gemini and OpenAI can degrade substantially on Llama, and gains from compressed output realization are strongly backend-dependent.

items.title: Evaluating Small Language Models for Front-Door Routing: A Harmonized Benchmark and Synthetic-Traffic Experiment
items.title_zh: 评估用于前置路由的小语言模型：统一基准与合成流量实验
items.summary: The paper tests whether 1-4B language models can handle front-door task routing, using a harmonized offline benchmark and a pre-registered four-arm synthetic-traffic experiment. Qwen-2.5-3B was Pareto-dominant among self-hosted models at 0.793 accuracy and 988 ms median latency with zero marginal cost, but no model met the pre-registered viability bar of 0.85 accuracy and 2,000 ms P95.

items.title: Can Small Models Reason About Legal Documents? A Comparative Study
items.title_zh: 小模型能推理法律文书吗？一项比较研究
items.summary: The study tests nine sub-10B models across ContractNLI, CaseHOLD and ECtHR with five prompting strategies, running 405 experiments. A mixture-of-experts model activating 3B parameters matched GPT-4o-mini in mean accuracy, while chain-of-thought helped contract entailment but hurt multiple-choice legal reasoning and BM25 and dense RAG gave near-identical results.

items.title: No Hard Negatives Required: Concept Centric Learning Leads to Compositionality without Degrading Zero-shot Capabilities of Contrastive Models
items.title_zh: 无需难负样本：以概念为中心的学习在不损害零样本能力的前提下实现组合性
items.summary: The authors attribute weak compositionality in contrastive vision-language models to long training captions and global pooling, and propose short concept-centric caption parts plus parameter-free cross-modal attention pooling. The changes reach state-of-the-art compositionality results while maintaining or improving zero-shot and retrieval performance without extra inference cost.

items.title: Mangi-11/Eta
items.title_zh: Mangi-11/Eta：可直接访问 Android 系统底层的 AI 智能体
items.summary: Eta is a Kotlin system-level Android AI agent with direct OS access that steps outside the sandbox, letting models reach low-level APIs, the screen, the terminal and user data.
